name: Diamond wheel, 1A1R, 6 x 0.035 x 1-1/4 in, 120 grit, on its own hub
description: Thin straight resin-bond diamond wheel for slotting carbide on the surface grinder, kept mounted between its own flanges on its own hub, as a carbide shop keeps its diamond wheel; grinds ct-tpg322's chipbreaker.

key_specs.name: Flanges
key_specs.note: proposed: the grinder STEP's flange size

key_specs.name: Mass

license: self-made from the listing's published dimensions (moonshot/library/stations/extract.py wheel_mesh); not a maker's CAD
notes: GENERIC: a plain disc between two flanges needs no download. Its dimensions are Butler Bros' listing of a 6 x 0.035 x 1-1/4 in 1A1R resin diamond wheel, 120 grit (1/4 in diamond depth, 6,048 rpm max); the hub's flanges are proposed. The same numbers mount it on the grinder (moonshot/library/stations/sgrind.json wheels), and extract.py writes both its own GLB and the grinder's link.
